newsitem.title: USA: Sungard sees full yr EPS at $1.86-$1.91.
newsitem.headline: Sungard sees full yr EPS at $1.86-$1.91.

text.p: SunGard Data Systems Inc expects 1997 earnings per share to be in the $1.86-$1.91 range, the company said in a statement accompanying earnings.

"Our first quarter results met our expectations and our 1997 outlook for fully diluted earnings per share continues to be in the range of $1.86 to $1.91, excluding a one-time charge for purchased in-process research and development that we expect to record in the second quarter," said chief executive James Mann.
Sungard, a computer service and software company, made a proforma fully diluted $1.59 per share for the whole of 1996.
